mvmnt-church-charlottesville.assessment: MVMNT Church is a vibrant, Spirit-filled non-denominational congregation in Charlottesville with strong community engagement. The church's emphasis on 'abundant life in Christ' and its welcoming posture toward diverse backgrounds speaks to an outreach heart. However, for a man doing theological due diligence, several key questions are unanswered from web research alone: Who is the lead pastor? Is there an explicit statement of faith? What is the view on women in pastoral leadership? Is preaching expository? The 'spirit-filled, non-denominational' combination without a confirmed doctrinal foundation warrants caution. MVMNT should be evaluated in person with direct doctrinal questions asked of leadership.

score_notes.christology: Church describes itself as 'Christ-centered' — implies orthodox Christology but not explicitly confirmed in available research.
score_notes.scripture: No explicit statement of faith confirmed. 'Spirit-filled, non-denominational' branding is a caution flag for potential experiential over scriptural priority.
score_notes.gender: CONFIRMED: Lead Pastors are 'Jeff & Kristy Nicolette' per /our-leadership and church-finder listings. Kristy Nicolette is formally titled 'Pastor' and has her own speaker page at mvmntchurch.com/media/speaker/Pastor+Kristy+Nicolette including sermons in 'Encounters With Jesus' series. Definitive RED.
score_notes.leadership: Husband-wife co-lead-pastor team. No plural elder structure visible. Multiple women in director roles (Martha Madigan Creative, Sarah Mensah Connections, etc.).
score_notes.soteriology: Christ-centered branding suggests evangelical soteriology, but no explicit faith-alone statement confirmed.
score_notes.cultural: 'Spirit-filled' branding; no overt progressive signals on visible pages but no statement-of-faith page accessible (404 on /about, /team, /who-we-are, /beliefs); content sparse and contemporary-experiential.
score_notes.preaching: Female lead pastor preaching confirmed via speaker page archive.
score_notes.mission: Active community service emphasis and 'people of all backgrounds' focus suggests genuine outreach heart.
score_notes.denominational: Non-denominational; legal entity 'Skyline Church, INC.' DBA MVMNT Church. No external accountability body. Self-governed.
